## Summary

Describe the defensive learning, documentation, test, accessibility, or safe-tooling improvement.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] The change is lawful, defensive, and authorization-first.
- [ ] No real credentials, secrets, private keys, tokens, or personal data are included.
- [ ] No unauthorized scanning, credential theft, malware, stealth/evasion, destructive action, or security-control bypass instructions are introduced.
- [ ] Datasets are synthetic, local, isolated, supplied, or explicitly authorized.
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated when appropriate.

## Validation

Describe how the change was checked.
